changes.appended_comment:
### Owner-approved retained-prototype end state — 2026-11-07

The owner chose “Keep the prototype installed” and explicitly requested completion of the remaining three closeout tasks; [closeout authorization](../../workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence/ticket-01-closeout-0115/closure-authorization.json) authorizes this acceptance amendment. Retention replaces mandatory uninstall/restoration only under experiment step 6 and criteria 8/10. No restoration was performed; preserve tripletap, credentials, editable notebooks and prior evidence, keep the old LAN proxy quarantined, and require fresh exact approval for owned-only future removal/rollback.

The retained evidence records [native Send and originating-request routing](../../workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence/tablet-activation-0054/native-send-0101-outcome.json) and its [returned annotated PNG](../../workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence/tablet-activation-0054/native-send-0101-returned.png), [owner-visible sleep/wake](../../workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence/tablet-activation-0054/owner-visible-sleep-wake-0104.json), [unassociated-document protection](../../workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence/tablet-activation-0054/unassociated-stock-notebook-0105.json), [ordinary full-boot limits](../../workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence/tablet-activation-0054/read-only-full-boot-probe-0107-boundary.json), [owner-installed tripletap boundary](../../workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence/tablet-activation-0054/tripletap-lifecycle-clarification-0108.json), [approved manual bridge start](../../workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence/tablet-activation-0054/owned-post-boot-bridge-start-0109-native-status.json), [post-boot editable-work recovery](../../workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence/tablet-activation-0054/post-boot-owner-recovery-0110.json), [real originating cancellation](../../workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence/tablet-activation-0054/originating-request-cancellation-0111-outcome.json), [native terminal status and continued editability](../../workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence/tablet-activation-0054/native-terminal-cancellation-0112.json), and the [restoration/security boundary](../../workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence/tablet-activation-0054/restoration-security-boundary-0113.json). Ordinary boot did not activate mods or the transient bridge; tripletap mods activation is owner-reported, and the owned Go bridge required a separately approved manual start. Only firmware `3.28.0.172` was tested; firmware updates and automatic bridge startup are unproved.

[Closeout run 0115](../../workflows/pi-ink-bridge-01-pen-prototype/artifacts/evidence/ticket-01-closeout-0115/) holds authorization and the build/version reconciliation still being collected; this amendment does not claim reconciliation, independent acceptance review, integration or publication has passed. Positive clipping/confirmation/invalidation is not an additional standalone ticket-01 gate. Production work remains scoped to tickets 02–10; no custom drawing surface or production startup/delivery hardening is added. Keep `work_status: claimed` until the parent completes independent review and integration/publication.
